s.note: kept in your pocket for later
s.how: Parboil 800g potatoes for 8 minutes, cool and grate. Squeeze dry and season with salt and 1 tsp onion powder. Shape into little cylinders and freeze 30 minutes. Fry at 180C until golden and crisp all over.

Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes, halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Brush with 30g melted butter and crisp at 220C for 10 minutes. Fill with 150g grated cheddar and 4 rashers crisp bacon, bake 5 minutes more, top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: cheese, tortilla, done properly in a pan
m.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g grated cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, then fold in half. Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Serve with diced tomato salsa and sour cream.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in an ovenproof bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Hollow the centre, fill with 200g lollies and cover with 400g icing sugar beaten with 250g butter in bright stripes.

d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into four tall glasses. For chocolate milk, whisk 3 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp sugar into a splash of hot milk first, then stir it through. Drink it like a champion.
